items.item_text: High school diploma or equivalent is required. Some college education is preferred.

Provides supervision to student staff on the sales floor including delegation of duties, problem solving and conflict resolution, and monitoring performance. Ensures excellent customer services and first rate floor maintenance including arranging displays, and ensuring that the sales floor is clean and visually appealing at all times. Processes sales and returns in the POS system, creating and processing departmental recharges, cash handling -including providing change for cashiers. Prepares purchase orders; may obtain sourcing and pricing information. Assists with ordering of convenience merchandise, such as weekly food orders. Performs opening and closing duties as a key holder of the campus store. This includes counting registers down at the end of the day and ensuring that student staff complete closing cleaning procedures.
Experience in a retail setting and customer service experience.
Good written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Active listening and time management skills.
